item.title: Zoning administrator, Gary Arrington, retiring after 18 years of service
item.description: HUNTINGTON — Mayor Leonard Norton called the Huntington City Council to order at 6:30 p.m. on Wednesday, Jan. 21, 2026. Following the approval of the consent agenda, two business licenses, Black Diamond Truck Pilot Services and Ashley Justice’s Pedi Energy, LLC were approved by the council.
